You know, seeing Stage 5 in the New Classic, I'm still convinced that all the curly things on the sides are shelves, and Reimu/Marisa beat Sakuya up in the storeroom or kitchen or gallery or something.

Anyway, she does say [**this**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Embodiment_of_Scarlet_Devil/Story/Reimu's_Scenario#:%7E:text=%E3%81%8A%E6%8E%83%E9%99%A4%E3%81%AE%E9%82%AA%E9%AD%94%E3%81%99%E3%82%8B) in EoSD.
